title: A pending erase from another device can be hidden by a Disconnect that lands between the pull and the sheet's onDismiss re-check
evidence: From the re-check of S48 (PR 1682). ios/HealthRoadmap/App/FirstRun.swift:112-116 Cover.onRecordChange answers closeOffer for an erase seen while the backup offer's sheet is up, and stores nothing; ios/HealthRoadmap/App/RootView.swift:208 closes the sheet and the sheets' onDismiss (:76, :84) runs recordChanged (:203) again, which works the erase out afresh (erasedElsewhere, :191-196). A Disconnect confirmed just before the pull (Sync/SyncView.swift:95) runs CloudSync.disconnectOutcome (Sync/CloudSync.swift:236), whose cloudClose(copyDown: true) (:239) copies the erased cloud record down and showPhone (:253) moves the source to the phone. If that lands during the close animation, source differs from onboardedSource, so the erased copy is counted (takeCount) and the questions never rise: an empty My health with no questions. No pre-erase values show (eraseEpoch is monotonic). Same root as main's gap where an erase arrives only inside the copy-down. Design note first. Options: compare the copied-down record's epoch with the cloud's own count before counting it under the phone, or hold the pending erase in a named state until the questions rise. Either with a test of connect, erase pulled, Disconnect landing before onDismiss. US-25 AC16d
